label: CBFA2T3::GLIS2

sections.text: CBFA2T3 encodes a transcriptional corepressor involved in hematopoietic differentiation.
GLIS2 encodes a zinc-finger transcriptional regulator.

The cryptic inv(16)(p13q24) fusion alters transcription through a CBFA2T3-containing GLIS2 protein and drives an aggressive pediatric AML program. It is associated with megakaryoblastic disease and the RAM immunophenotype, including strong CD56 and weak or absent CD45/CD38.
Pediatric CBFA2T3::GLIS2 AML has high relapse risk and poor survival in reported cohorts.
